healthy2024.area: serum insulin incremental area, below-baseline handling unspecified

shukla2015.location: Table 1, insulin iAUC row 0-120, mean and SEM
shukla2015.design: Metformin-treated T2D, 628 kcal, 55 g protein, 68 g carbohydrate, 16 g fat; fixed first visit carbohydrate first, rest of meal 15 min later; reverse order one week later. First-bite samples 0,30,60,120. Below-baseline convention unspecified. Wilcoxon matched-pairs signed rank test.

shukla2017.location: Table 2 insulin row in SI units, mean and SEM
shukla2017.design: Random order in T2D. Three 30-min meals; 10 min eating, 10 min rest, 10 min eating. Sandwich and juice in two halves in mixed schedule. Table 2 marks last vs first insulin significance, not last vs sandwich. Related investigative group to 2015, cohort overlap unestablished.
shukla2017.missingness: One of 16 lacked sandwich data. The printed sandwich mean is used without imputation.
shukla2017.sampling_note: Methods state every 30 minutes to 180; Table 2 footnote omits 120 and 150. The published insulin iAUC is used directly; clipping unspecified.

imai2023.location: Table 2 insulin IAUC 120 min row, mean and SEM
imai2023.design: Healthy young women, randomized crossover. Both slow conditions 20 min. Rice 6 min, fish 7 min, vegetables with oil 7 min in forward or reverse order. First-bite samples 0,30,60,120. Explicit above-baseline trapezoid; paired treatment contrast p<0.01 according to Table 2. Fast last context only. Total 671 kcal, C105.4g, P24.5g, F16.3g.
